messages:
quentin: FYI support ticket from CrateLabs — multiple 5xx/timeouts since ~2026-03-17T10:15:00Z. Tenant=54321, customer reports spike in API failures and very high p95 (several 10s). Can we triage? :warning:
opsbot: ALERT ingested: ingress.queue_depth.prod > 95th_percentile (host-group a1)
opsbot: continuous_batcher.backlog.size > 8000 for host a1-03
samir: oncall here. grabbing traces and logs. are these 5xx from gateway or backend inference? any auth/billing errors in support ticket?
quentin: support says mostly 504/timeouts and some 502s. no auth or billing errors reported by customer, they see retries on their side. attaching sample trace-id: trace-8a7c2f
maya: runtime note — seeing sustained longseq tail. sequence_length  > 2048 for a subset of requests, KV cache miss rate jumped to 72%. Continuous batcher windows are stretching; backlog depth increased and dequeue latency p95 -> 28s on a1-03.
maya: logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-17T10:14:53Z] host=a1-03 batcher=continuous queue_depth=8123 dequeue_latency_p95=28.4s kv_miss_rate=0.72 trace=trace-8a7c2f
[2026-03-17T10:15:12Z] host=a1-03 model=redwood-xxl tokens_inflight=1.2M
```
lina: I can query live metrics. running quick check now; will post alerts link.
lina: metrics query: rdrctl metrics query "ingress.queue_depth{env=prod,host=a1-03}" -> 8123 ; continuous_batcher.backlog_count{host=a1-03}=7890
quentin: thanks. any chance customer started a bulk job or ramped a pipeline?
maya: customer traffic shows small fraction (~0.7%) of requests with huge seq lengths coming in a tight loop — likely an internal batcher on their side; but our gateway keeps them in queue because no rejection. Their requests are high-cost and block batching for others.
samir: immediate mitigation ideas?
maya: short term: 1) throttle tenant 54321 ingress qps; 2) enable fallback routing to smaller model for that tenant; 3) reduce continuous_batcher.max_delay_ms from 40 -> 10 to avoid long windows; 4) consider temporary queue_depth_limit override to shed after X requests.
lina: I can flip a rate limit on tenant 54321 now via admin API. command: ```
adminctl tenant throttle --tenant=54321 --qps=10 --reason="ingress spike"
```
samir: do it and post confirmation. also set a tag so automated billing/alerts record this mitigation.
quentin: I'll draft customer-facing message: short explanation + ETA.
opsbot: AUTO: runbook matched: "ingress > queue_depth high -> throttle tenant / enable fallback" (runbook v2.1)
maya: I'll prepare config patch for batching param change. patches will be pushed to the rollout queue with canary on a1-09 first. change: continuous_batcher.max_delay_ms=10, continuous_batcher.kv_prefetch=true (to help misses).
lina: throttle applied: tenant=54321 qps=10 — API returned OK. monitoring for 5m.
quentin: customer notified: "We've throttled a small subset of traffic and are applying targeted mitigations to reduce timeouts. ETA 30m, will follow up with postmortem."
samir: after throttle we should watch queue_depth and dequeue latency. Lina, post graphs in 5/15/30 min. Maya, proceed with canary.
maya: starting canary now. pushing batching config to a1-09. will monitor latency and error rate.
maya: canary results after 2m: dequeue_p95 down from 28s -> 9.1s on a1-09, queue_depth on that host reduced by ~65%.
lina: overall queue_depth across a1 group dropped from 8123 -> 2200 in 7m after throttling + canary. 5xx rate reduced by 78%.
quentin: excellent. next steps: - keep throttle in place for 1h, - run short loadtest to validate: use wrk script (see below) - schedule postmortem once stable.
quentin: repro load command for infra/e2e: ```
wrk -t12 -c400 -d60s -s ./post-large-seq.lua --latency http://gateway.prod.internal/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```
quentin: post-large-seq.lua will send many longseq requests to mimic customer pattern (seq len ~2500). Maya/Lina, please do a controlled run on staging first.
maya: noted. suspects for longer-term: add tenant-level protection to detect heavy longseq patterns and auto-fallback, consider queue isolation per-tenant, and surface KVCACHE miss spikes to support UI so we can alert customers proactively.
samir: assign owners: samir = incident lead, maya = runtime mitigation & follow-up, lina = monitoring & metrics, quentin = customer comms. escalate to eng-platform if we need capacity changes.
quentin: closing loop: after 40m stability check I'll update ticket and schedule 1-hr postmortem meeting. thanks team :thumbsup:
summary: Customer tenant 54321 caused continuous-batcher backlog via high long-sequence traffic. Mitigations: tenant throttle, batching param canary (reduced max_delay_ms), enable KV prefetch, temporary fallback routing. Deployed canary; metrics improved; 5xxs reduced. Owners assigned for postmortem and long-term protections.
